newsletter.markdown:
1. **Discovery & Translational Science** — targets, mechanisms, biomarkers, and preclinical research:
   - **[Biotech]** **Research advances in drug discovery technologies** evaluated historical timelines from proof-of-concept to FDA approval, noting 15 years for fragment-based drug discovery (1996 to first approval) and 12 years for aptamers (1992 to 2004), while highlighting that DNA-encoded libraries have yet to yield an approved drug [Science Blog](https://www.science.org/content/blog-post/new-drug-technologies-and-their-histories).
   - **Transcriptomic insights in rheumatic heart disease** identified marked upregulation of B-cell-related pathways, including CD20-associated and multiple immunoglobulin genes in rheumatic mitral valve tissues, establishing a pathogenic role for B cells [BioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.17.26367998).
   - **Plasma proteomic analysis** of the LATTICE clinical trial identified GDF15 as a candidate biomarker associated with amyloid-beta status, disease progression, and response to low-dose lithium carbonate treatment in patients with mild cognitive impairment [BioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.14.26368038).

2. **Early Trials — Phase I–II** — first-in-human, dose-finding, and proof-of-concept studies:
   - **[Biotech]** **Phase I safety of CYT-101 with pembrolizumab** in 9 recurrent glioblastoma patients showed no dose-limiting toxicities, demonstrating polyfunctional activity, broad HLA restriction, and potent cytolytic function from allogeneic cytomegalovirus-specific T cells combined with checkpoint blockade [BioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.17.26367100).
   - **[Biotech]** **CONSORTiUM-IO Phase 1 trial** evaluating VE800 (a clonal consortium of 11 commensal bacterial strains) combined with nivolumab in advanced PD-1-refractory melanoma, gastric/GEJ adenocarcinoma, and MSS colorectal cancer found the combination was well tolerated but offered no improvement over historic response rates [BioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.13.26368051).
   - **B-cell depletion feasibility study** in children with rheumatic heart disease in Dakar, Senegal, demonstrated that treatment with the anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody rituximab was well tolerated, reduced anti-streptolysin O titers, and showed clinical improvement compared to controls [BioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.17.26367998).

3. **Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III** — pivotal/registrational trials and practice-changing efficacy or safety readouts:
   - **[Biotech]** **CALMA trial completion** reached the end of its six-week treatment phase across all 170 participants, with topline data anticipated between December and January [X / Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2123041687673208870).

4. **Regulatory & Approvals** — FDA/EMA actions:
   - **[Big Pharma]** **Roche secures FDA approval for Wilserdly (giredestrant)** as a breast cancer pill, marking a key first step in a major commercial launch for what the company projects could become its top-selling product [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/roche-fda-approve-wilserdly-giredestrant-breast-cancer/874884/).
   - **[Biotech]** **Nuvalent receives FDA accelerated approval for Nelkarmi (neladalkib)** for adults with locally advanced or metastatic ALK-positive non-small cell lung cancer previously treated with specific ALK TKIs and platinum-based chemotherapy [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/cancer-approvals/fda-grants-accelerated-approval-neladalkib-previously-treated-locally-advanced-or-metastatic-alk).
   - **FDA approves Lembaz (adrabetadex)** injection as the first treatment shown to reduce the risk of death in adult and pediatric patients weighing at least 7 kg with infantile-onset Niemann-Pick disease type C [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-drug-shown-help-patients-infantile-onset-niemann-pick-disease-type-c-live-longer).
   - **[Biotech]** **Inovio submits conditional MAA** to the European Medicines Agency for Voceryq for treating adults with recurrent respiratory papillomatosis [X / Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2123041011681349749).
   - **FDA publishes complete response letters**, including the disclosed rationale for Summit Therapeutics' rejected lung cancer drug [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/18/biotech-news-fda-discloses-reasons-for-rejecting-summit-drug/?utm_campaign=rss) and Regeneron's linvoseltamab CRL from August 2024 [X / Twitter](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2123050307374436652).
   - **FDA launches Global Reliance Disclosure Program (GRDP)** to share minimally redacted approval packages and regulatory assessments directly with international health authorities to accelerate global patient access [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-launches-global-reliance-disclosure-program-expand-patient-access-medicines-worldwide).

5. **Business & Strategy** — deals, licensing, M&A, financings, and pipeline reprioritization:
   - **[Big Pharma]** **Merck terminates nemtabrutinib development**, effectively writing off its 2.7 billion dollar acquisition of Arqule after seven years [X / Twitter](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2122995213144592818).
   - **[Big Pharma]** **Pfizer enters an exclusive licensing agreement** with Starna Therapeutics for autoimmune disease assets, with Starna receiving an upfront payment of 330 million dollars [X / Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2123021866264932790).
   - **[Biotech]** **Flagship Pioneering commits 100 million pounds** to launch a new U.K. outpost focused on creating AI-native platform companies spanning human and planetary health [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/17/biotech-news-flagship-opens-biotech-creation-uk-outpost/?utm_campaign=rss).
   - **[Biotech]** **Ipsen partner Ipha reports low response rates** with 1 confirmed response among 19 post-Padcev urothelial cancer patients, accompanied by stomatitis as a dose-limiting toxicity, sending shares down 7% [X / Twitter](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2122996438787563743).

6. **Public Health & Policy** — outbreaks, vaccination, and policy:
   - **US loses measles elimination status** as officially declared by the Pan American Health Organization, driven by a national and regional surge in vaccine refusal and the re-establishment of endemic transmission in the United States, Mexico, and Bolivia [Science-Based Medicine](https://sciencebasedmedicine.org/us-losses-measles-elimination-status/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=us-losses-measles-elimination-status).
   - **White House withdraws the nomination** of Heidi Overton to lead the FDA amid mounting Senate confirmation hurdles and controversy surrounding her past work on vaping [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/17/heidi-overton-fda-commissioner-nomination-withdrawn/?utm_campaign=rss).
   - **Sen. Bill Cassidy rejects Jim O'Neill**, the White House pick to lead the National Science Foundation, citing a failure to stand up for science [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/18/bill-cassidy-rejects-jim-oneill-lead-national-science-foundation/?utm_campaign=rss).
   - **Federal health regulators update the HIPAA privacy rule** to establish enhanced data privacy standards and support patient access to personal medical records shared with third-party applications [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/17/hipaa-privacy-rule-update-aims-to-improve-patient-access-to-records/?utm_campaign=rss).

youtube.markdown:
- Biology & Health
    - [The AI Bubble Won't Kill AI](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/sEvnaio7kSw) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Stephanie Davis discusses why frontier AI labs may retain their value even if an AI bubble bursts.
        - The crowded market of AI-assisted revenue cycle startups is identified as being far more vulnerable.
        - The analysis highlights structural differences in market resilience between underlying AI infrastructure/frontier tech and application-layer startups in healthcare.
    - [Building Software Is No Longer the Hard Part](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/WBprp2o0tyQ) -- Health2Tech
        - Bret Waters explains that AI has significantly reduced the cost and increased the speed of software development.
        - Building the actual software is no longer considered the hardest part of creating a tech product.
        - Understanding customers and solving real-world problems remain the most difficult challenges for entrepreneurs and startups.
- Tech & Engineering
    - [Un chercheur vient de créer le détecteur d’IA presque parfait](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D-NRC_wnJbc) -- Underscore_
        - A researcher has created an almost perfect AI image detector named Mammouth AI.
        - The video highlights the difficulty humans face in spotting AI-generated images without specialized detection tools.
        - Mammouth AI is presented in collaboration with its cofounder, alongside resources like label4.ai.
- Other
    - [Why Does Congress Skew Older Than the Public?: Crash Course US Government #8](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DC5l7pXDQVo) -- CrashCourse
        - Congress is more diverse today than it was ten, fifty, or a hundred years ago, yet it still fails to fully reflect the demographic diversity of the United States.
        - The episode examines whether Congress will ever look like the general public and evaluates whether demographic representation in legislature actually matters.
        - Topics covered include congressional representation, different types of representation, instances where representation falls short, and historical changes in Congressional demographics.
